blocking_issues.location: sections on transcontinental geography, EU manufacturing integration, Black Sea/Mediterranean corridors, energy dependence and external relations
blocking_issues.issue: The dossier makes spatial distribution, corridor exposure, country-to-country dependence and external relationships central to its thesis but contains no map. RESEARCH-VISUALS.md and COUNTRY-CONTEXT.md require a map by editorial judgment when those mechanisms are central and clearer spatially than in prose.
blocking_issues.evidence: The reviewed EN/PT-BR sources contain multiple quantitative charts and structural flow material, but repository search found no map block for the Türkiye dossier. The opening and scope explicitly frame Türkiye as a connector among Europe, the Black Sea, Mediterranean, Caucasus and Middle East, while later analysis depends on EU supply chains and energy corridors.

required_fixes: Add an evidence-bearing deterministic map in both EN and PT-BR with semantic parity. Encode only geographic mechanisms already supported by cited evidence, such as EU manufacturing linkage, Black Sea/Mediterranean access, energy corridors and relevant neighboring-region exposure; do not invent quantitative flows or geographic precision.
Re-run the visual floor, mobile legibility and EN/PT-BR visual-parity checks after adding the map, returning the same ID with changed source SHAs.
evidence: TURKSTAT confirms August 2026 CPI at 31.51% and Q2 2026 real GDP growth at 2.3% year on year.
CBRT confirms the policy rate was maintained at 37% on 10 September 2026.

RESEARCH-VISUALS.md makes visual readiness blocking and requires a map by editorial judgment when spatial distribution, corridor exposure, regional transmission or country-to-country dependence is central.
COUNTRY-CONTEXT.md specifically directs use of a map when trade corridors, energy dependence, regional inequality or external relationships are central.
